label: The fish records
does: The Province's electrofishing export is read, one row per site visit, with its catch and fished area; repeat loads of one survey are kept once.

label: Putting sites on the stream map
does: Each visit's mapped point is snapped to the Freshwater Atlas streams twice: to the nearest one, and to the streams its FDIS 1:50k tributary code names. A visit takes the nearest named stream within reach, even where another is nearer; a visit with no code takes the nearest stream and is kept only when it is near enough; a visit whose code names no stream within reach is dropped.
inputs: FDIS site points; Freshwater Atlas streams; fwa_streams_20k_50k

label: link's stream segments
does: link breaks the Atlas streams into segments and codes each one's access and habitat for every species, province-wide.

label: How much water each stream carries
does: Each segment takes wet's default flow: PCIC's routed flow, carried onto Atlas streams by the fwapg fork's crosswalk, unless it does not reach the segment or, on a segment of its own watershed's line, carries far less than the balance's; wet's water balance there.
inputs: PCIC VIC-GL runoff routed by Raven; wet's water balance

label: Joining each site to its segment
does: Each placed visit takes link's segment and its gradient, access, flow, width, barriers downstream and the walks to rivers of each size, and each species' presence where link expects it.
inputs: placed visits; link's schema (SCHEMA, checked by knw_build_record); discharge.fwa_v1_segment_monthly

label: Candidate rules
does: A grid of rules is built around link's own thresholds: a size floor, a gradient maximum, and an exception near a river.
outputs: candidate rules per species and stage

label: Scoring and choosing
does: Every rule is scored on watershed groups it was not fitted to; the rules close to the best form the region, and the pick is the region's rule closest to link's default.

label: Checking the choice is not luck
does: The choice is repeated on more fold seeds, under nested selection and on bootstrap resamples of watershed groups.

label: A curve and a grade
does: A smooth curve of use on size, distance to the pick's river and gradient is fitted, and every segment is graded by its predicted use, unless the curve does no better than no rule.

label: Running the rule on link's streams
does: The tuned rule and link's default are each run through fresh's predicate, link's user-habitat overlay and the connectivity pass on copies of link's segments, and compared.

label: Publishing
does: The tuned thresholds, in link's parameter names, and the grades are written as tables and Parquet sets.
